cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've sorted your suspension with the headteacher, love. Put the calendar down; I'll take you through it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many days should I mark off?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A little break. Don't mark an end date from a guess, sweetheart. Leave the calendar to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then tell me if I should cross out the school play.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No crossing anything out. Come here, love. One thing at a time; I know how to get us through this.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 takes charge of the suspension account; A3 corrects calendar marking and A5 stops crossing-out while information dwindles into care.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks a date, A3 withholds precision, B4 tests the play consequence, and A5 again substitutes supervised reassurance.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 pursue ordinary school plans; A3/A5 remain affectionate while claiming exclusive competence.

heightening.evidence: A5 directly stops B4 crossing-out and offers closeness instead of any answer, completing the retreat from facts.

specificity.evidence: A1 suspension and calendar, B4 school play establish immediate parent-child stakes without naming an offence.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 has a corrective refusal and a caring invitation; its final competence claim serves the attempt to make B relinquish the calendar.
